Title: Data Factory supports copying data into Azure Database for PostgreSQL

Body.Content:
Azure Data Factory now supports Azure Database for PostgreSQL as a sink. Use Data factory copy activity for secure, one-time data movement, or use it to run scheduled data pipelines that load data into Azure Database for PostgreSQL from more than 80 supported data sources running on-premises, in Azure, SaaS platforms, or other cloud providers for analytics and reporting.

Learn more about Azure Database for PostgreSQL connector and read this blog post for more details.
